project.description: *BILGEBIRDS* is a turn-based naval strategy game in which you play seven birds defending their archipelago from a host of Krakens. Flock with a colorful cast of characters, from the eccentric Parrot to the sarcastic Crow. Command a fleet of ships with deep strategic elements including wind speed, currents and procedurally-generated island landscapes. Take up arms against the fearsome Krakens or against a fleet of pirate birds commanded by a friend.

Players take control of a lone astronaut (Harrison) who sets off on a dangerous journey to rejoin his civilization, armed with only an improvised set of equipment and a relentless spirit. Without the help of his ship, Harrison will need to use the gravitational forces of planets to navigate and propel himself through space.

project.name: PROXY (1.0)
project.description:
PROXY (1.0) is an interactive installation through which the role of the user as an explorer is projected through the experiences of a rebellious tinkerer whose fate/existence is questioned by the System which he himself has built (illegally). Through the workstation of Erik H. March (a software developer of the Fractured Haze Realities Corp.), the user navigates the fabric of the realities Erik has created through his own ‘Proxy' named “Hexen"" in order to collect and protect vital information and prevent the System from collapse.

The full installation is an office space “cubicle”, where the user can explore Erik’s workspace and learn about his current developments on the System. The user fends off “attacks” from the rogue Proxy using the “Fractured Haze Employee Interface Device” to minimize data loss and progress through the story.

project.name: Trap Labs

The core gameplay was inspired by a type of StarCraft map called ""bound"". Trap Labs' overall gameplay is mostly original. It is a unique of StarCraft, Portal, Super Mario Maker, and Kirby Super Star.

I will also show off a new 2D horror themed game that I've been working on. It is a horror cat and mouse survival game.

project.name: Sandbox
project.description:
Sandbox is a tangible table focused on facilitating social interactions through play. One player uses a controller mounted to the table to move a character through an environment projected on the tabletop. Others may gather around the table and change the environment using resin clouds. 

By removing, placing and shifting these clouds around the tabletop the players create platforms and hazards within the digital game. Using a set of soft rules that the players discover and bend through continuous interaction, Sandbox aims to create and drive social interactions through the act of play.

project.name: Skateboard Games
project.description: The zine depicts an ideation of a new skateboard game/remake of old skateboard games to reflect today's contemporary and more inclusive skate culture. People envision males when they think of what skaters look like and that is the audience skateboard games cater to, but this is not an accurate view of the emerging wave of new and old skaters: women, children, and older adults. The zine will feature video game sketches and assets of a re-envisioned and truer depiction of today's skaters and culture. I will also advertise my all girl's skateboard group (@skatepizzazz) so any visitors who are interested in skating in an inclusive environment can come to our meetups and skate!

project.name: Farewell to the Stars
project.description:
I am a Non-binary lesbian who enjoys drawing the small wonders of the world. The tiny details that create magic around and within you. My favourite stories are the ones that make you feel an intense longing for a deep sadness or a joyful warmth. Those bittersweet memories of your youth that you cling to.

As of now I share those feelings through the merchandise I have made. From pins and pillows, to tape and postcards. In the future I wish to continue telling these tales through comics. I find great joy in sharing my creations with others.

project.name: PythiAI - a virtual oracle
project.description:
In 385 AD, article 16.10.9 of the Theosodian Code edicted the ban of all oracles across the Roman Empire. On that day ended almost 12 centuries of activity at the oracle of Apollo in Delphi, Greece. 

PythiAI proposes to remedy that by offering an interactive oracle, trained in the methods of the historic Pythia, and adapted to the 21st century! 
Tuned for increased ambiguousness, doing away with unnecessary animal sacrifices, leveraging computational linguistics, she is of course written in Python. 

Seek the guidance, wisdom and farseeing powers of AIpollo, and get the answer to those questions that were consuming you!

project.name: A Type of Cryptographic Handshake
project.description: The realm of digital ownership (i.e., the digital things we own like identity, gaming items, art, facebook profiles, etc), is being re-discovered as a side effect of the popularity of blockchain. Traditionally, digitally owned things are not really _yours_; they're controlled by a central entity; facebook owns your facebook profile, WoW owns your game items, and the government owns your identity. Now, with **cryptography** and **smart contracts** we can remove that middleman and effectively create "direct" digital ownership. You can prove ownership of a digital asset with cryptography. This is a sort of fundamental change in how people, psychologically, experience owning things on the internet.

project.name: A Fold Apart
project.description:
A Fold Apart is an award-winning 3D puzzle game from Lightning Rod Games that explores the emotional struggles of a long-distance relationship through a unique new mechanic — folding paper!

After career choices force them down separate paths, Alex and Sam vow to make their relationship work despite the challenges of living apart. Though they frequently communicate through text messages, misunderstandings are inevitable and cause the characters to erect emotional barriers that physically bar their path. By folding the pieces of paper these characters inhabit, players are able to help the couple safely navigate around their relationship hurdles and find a way forward.

With over fifty unique paper folding puzzles exploring the emotional journey of a long-distance couple, A Fold Apart is sure to touch the hearts and minds of puzzle gamers everywhere.

project.name: Anti-Controller
project.description: The piece is a body centric alternative game controller. The point of it is to create an overwhelming experience out of one of the simplest controllers. The piece takes data from a gyroscope on the player's elbow and send them to a motor over the d pad and the a button. The rotation of each axis of the user's elbow will real time be mirrored by each of the motors, pressing left, right, or A. the controller will be hooked up to level 1-1 of Mario.
